summary.text: Robin Littau is a Republican small-business owner and elected Enterprise Elementary School District board member in Redding who served in the U.S. Coast Guard from 1997 to 2001. According to her Ballotpedia survey response, she was born and raised in South Dakota and has lived in California for 28 years. She says her campaign centers on reducing taxation and burdensome legislation and on integrity, transparency and trust in government.

paragraphs.text: Littau says she was born and raised in South Dakota with farming and ranching roots. She graduated from Sturgis Brown High School and attended Shasta College.

She served in the U.S. Coast Guard from 1997 to 2001 as a diesel mechanic (MK3), and describes an honorable discharge and receiving a life-saving ribbon and a 9/11 ribbon. She says she has lived in California for 28 years: in Alameda (2 years), Bodega Bay (2 years), Sacramento (15 years) and Redding (10 years).

Littau owns and operates two sole-proprietor small businesses, Rockin Robin's Cleaning Service and Joyful Living Magazine. She serves as an elected member of the Enterprise Elementary School District board (term 2024-2026), her only elected office listed on Ballotpedia.
She describes herself as a single mother of four children and says she has done community service including overseeing a neighborhood watch, a single mothers' support group and a weekly youth group.
